sqlSafetyGuard.title: SQL Safety Guard
sqlSafetyGuard.description: Analyze SQL before execution and configure when the guard asks for confirmation. Settings apply immediately. Import validates and previews changes before applying them.

sqlSafetyGuard.guardMode.title: F5 warnings
sqlSafetyGuard.guardMode.description: Choose when executing SQL requires confirmation. Unknown execution targets always require confirmation.

sqlSafetyGuard.showConnection.title: Show connection in confirmation
sqlSafetyGuard.showConnection.description: Show the server and database in the execution confirmation. Unknown connection details always stay visible.

sqlSafetyGuard.allowList.title: Safe tables allow-list
sqlSafetyGuard.allowList.description: Matching data writes become green. This authorizes the target and its side effects; DDL stays red. Use Edit list for one pattern per line; semicolons also work.

sqlSafetyGuard.trustedProcedures.title: Trusted procedures
sqlSafetyGuard.trustedProcedures.description: Explicitly authorized procedures become green without inspecting their bodies. Use schema-qualified names; wildcards are allowed only in the final part. Use Edit list for one entry per line.

sqlSafetyGuard.environmentRules.title: Environment rules
sqlSafetyGuard.environmentRules.description: First matching server/database rule wins. Rule lists ADD to global lists. Unknown connections use global settings. Use Edit rules for a larger editor and the rule format. See docs/user-guide.md for examples.

sqlSafetyGuard.tempdbIsTemp.title: Permanent tempdb objects are temporary
sqlSafetyGuard.tempdbIsTemp.description: Off by default. Turning this on makes writes to permanent shared tempdb objects green. Local and global temporary tables are already treated as temporary.
